scripts.build: pnpm build:browser && pnpm --filter @needware/web build && node scripts/generate_offline.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: python3 scripts/token_guard.py run 'cargo run -p xtask -- revision-fixture && pnpm exec playwright test'
scripts.audit:dependencies: python3 scripts/token_guard.py run 'cargo audit && cargo deny check && pnpm audit --audit-level=moderate'
scripts.contracts: python3 scripts/token_guard.py run 'cargo run -p xtask -- contracts'
